30664-callista-a-tale-of-the-third-centu.creator: Unknown
30664-callista-a-tale-of-the-third-centu.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He did no more till the end of last July, when he suddenly resumed the thread of his tale, and has been successful so far as this, that he has brought it to an end.

33940-a-voice-on-the-wind-and-other-poem.title: And Other Poems
33940-a-voice-on-the-wind-and-other-poem.creator: Madison Cawein
33940-a-voice-on-the-wind-and-other-poem.description: A book by Madison Cawein. face is raised to the blinding gale;   Whose hair blows black and whose eyes are pale,   While over the world is heard her wail,--  "O, my children, come home, come home! O, my children, come home!"

arxiv-2011-07482.title: Towards Trainable Saliency Maps in Medical Imaging
arxiv-2011-07482.creator: Mehak Aggarwal 1, Nishanth Arun 1, Sharut Gupta 1, Ashwin Vaswani 1, Bryan Chen 1, Matthew Li 1, Ken Chang 1,2, Jay Patel 1,2, Katherine Hoebel 1, Mishka Gidwani 1, Jayashree Kalpathy-Cramer 1, Praveer Singh 1,2
arxiv-2011-07482.description: Abstract While success of Deep Learning (DL) in automated diagnosis can be transformative to the medicinal practice especially for people with little or no access to doctors, its widespread acceptability is severely limited by inherent black-box decision making and unsafe failure modes.

arxiv-2111-11501.title: Quantum description of angles in the plane
arxiv-2111-11501.creator: Roberto Beneduci, Emmanuel Frion
arxiv-2111-11501.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Roberto Beneduci, Emmanuel Frion. The real plane with its set of orientations or angles in [ 0 , π ) [0,\pi) is the simplest non trivial example of a (projective) Hilbert space and provides nice illustrations of quantum formalism. We present some of them, namely covariant integral quantization, linear polarisation of light as a quantum measurement, interpretation of entanglement leading to the violation of Bell inequalities, and spin one-half coherent states viewed as two entangled angles.

arxiv-2210-11327.title: Improving Data Quality with Training Dynamics of Gradient Boosting Decision Trees
arxiv-2210-11327.creator: Moacir A. Ponti, Lucas de Angelis Oliveira, Valentina Garcia, Mathias Esteban, Juan Martín Román, Luis Argerich
arxiv-2210-11327.description: Abstract Real world datasets contain incorrectly labeled instances that hamper the performance of the model and, in particular, the ability to generalize out of distribution. Also, each example might have different contribution towards learning. This motivates studies to better understanding of the role of data instances with respect to their contribution in good metrics in models.

arxiv-2303-07088.title: Differential voltage analysis for battery manufacturing process control
arxiv-2303-07088.creator: Andrew Weng, Jason B. Siegel, Anna Stefanopoulou
arxiv-2303-07088.description: Abstract Voltage-based battery metrics are ubiquitous and essential in battery manufacturing diagnostics. They enable electrochemical “fingerprinting” of batteries at the end of the manufacturing line and are naturally scalable, since voltage data is already collected as part of the formation process which is the last step in battery manufacturing.

arxiv-2308-01939.title: Numerical Uncertainty of Convolutional Neural Networks Inference for Structural Brain MRI Analysis
arxiv-2308-01939.creator: Inés Gonzalez Pepe, Vinuyan Sivakolunthu, Hae Lang Park, Yohan Chatelain, Tristan Glatard
arxiv-2308-01939.description: Abstract This paper investigates the numerical uncertainty of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) inference for structural brain MRI analysis. It applies Random Rounding—a stochastic arithmetic technique— to CNN models employed in non-linear registration (SynthMorph) and whole-brain segmentation (FastSurfer), and compares the resulting numerical uncertainty to the one measured in a reference image-processing pipeline (FreeSurfer recon-all).

arxiv-2410-14494.title: The application of Hough transform for fast interaction vertex position estimation in heavy-ion collisions
arxiv-2410-14494.creator: Tomasz Bołd, Petr Balek
arxiv-2410-14494.description: Abstract Track reconstruction in high-multiplicity events, such as heavy-ion collisions at LHC, is a difficult and resource-demanding process. A priori knowledge of the collision vertex position would allow discarding non-viable track seeds, reducing the overall computing requirements for the track reconstruction.

arxiv-2501-03390.title: State-of-the-art Methods for Pseudo-Boolean Solving with SCIP
arxiv-2501-03390.creator: Gioni Mexi, Dominik Kamp, Yuji Shinano, Shanwen Pu, Alexander Hoen, Ksenia Bestuzheva, Christopher Hojny, Matthias Walter, Marc E. Pfetsch, Sebastian Pokutta, Thorsten Koch
arxiv-2501-03390.description: Abstract The Pseudo-Boolean problem deals with linear or polynomial constraints with integer coefficients over Boolean variables. The objective lies in optimizing a linear objective function, or finding a feasible solution, or finding a solution that satisfies as many constraints as possible.

arxiv-2504-10131.title: A three-functor formalism for commutative von Neumann algebras
arxiv-2504-10131.creator: André G. Henriques and Thomas A. Wasserman
arxiv-2504-10131.description: Abstract . A three-functor formalism is the half of a six-functor formalism that supports the projection and base change formulas. In this paper, we provide a three-functor formalism for commutative von Neumann algebras and their modules. Using the Gelfand-Naimark theorem, this gives rise to a three-functor formalism for measure spaces and measurable bundles of Hilbert spaces.

britannica-1911-vogler-georg-joseph.description: Article 'Vogler, Georg Joseph' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. On his return to Mannheim in 1755 Vogler was appointed court chaplain and second "maestro di cappella." He now established his first great music school. His pupils were devoted to him, but he made innumerable enemies, for the principles upon which he taught were opposed to those of all other teachers.

europmc-pmc2692002.creator: Sehlmeyer C, Schöning S, Zwitserlood P, Pfleiderer B, Kircher T, Arolt V, Konrad C.
europmc-pmc2692002.description: Fear conditioning and extinction are basic forms of associative learning that have gained considerable clinical relevance in enhancing our understanding of anxiety disorders and facilitating their treatment. Modern neuroimaging techniques have significantly aided the...

pmc-11515746.title: Influence of SARS-CoV-2 variants on COVID-19 epidemiological and clinical profiles: a comparative analysis of two waves of cases
pmc-11515746.creator: Pérola Rodrigues dos Santos, Uener Ribeiro dos Santos, Íris Terezinha Santos de Santana Silva, Hllytchaikra Ferraz Fehlberg, Fabrício Barbosa Ferreira, George Rego Albuquerque, Ana Paula Melo Mariano, Murillo Ferreira da Silva, Leonardo Santos Lemos, Karoline Almeida Piton, Mylene de Melo Silva, Ren
pmc-11515746.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has been the most significant health challenge of the last century. Multiple and successive waves of COVID-19 cases, driven particularly by the emergence of new SARS-CoV-2 variants, have kept the world in a constant state of alert.

pmc-12588394.title: Identifying Gaps in Bolivian Neurosurgery: A Systematic Review and Proposed Framework for Resource Implementation
pmc-12588394.creator: Caleigh S Roach, Jacob J Shawwa, Connor S Nee, Jacqueline L Brenner, Vagif Kazimli, Shreyas Chetan, Jorge D Brun, Joyce Koueik, Richard Moser, Bermans Iskandar, Jorge D Brun, Victor M Lu
pmc-12588394.description: Neurosurgical systems in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) often face challenges in infrastructure, technology, workforce, and continuity of care. Bolivia, an LMIC in South America, remains underrepresented in global neurosurgical research. Correspondingly, this study aimed to systematically review the neurosurgical literature of Bolivia to identify existing strengths, key gaps, and opportunities for targeted investment and technological implementation.

pmc-12686649.title: Mitigating acrylamide formation using agrifood waste materials: A concise review☆
pmc-12686649.creator: Mouandhe Imamou Hassani
pmc-12686649.description: Acrylamide is a toxic compound that occurs in thermally processed foods. Food waste valorisation is a common trend that alleviates the environmental burden by upcycling agricultural waste into higher-value materials. In this perspective, this review examined the potential of using agricultural waste to reduce acrylamide in food products, and the eventual challenges.

pmc-12707407.title: Factors influencing glaucoma medication adherence: A qualitative study of patients and ophthalmologists in India
pmc-12707407.creator: Deborah Bott, Sirisha Senthil, Ahalya Subramanian, David F Edgar, John G Lawrenson, Peter Campbell
pmc-12707407.description: Purpose:Adherence to glaucoma medication helps prevent disease progression. Barriers to adherence exist, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. We explored factors influencing medication adherence from the perspectives of patients and ophthalmologists in India.Design:Cross-sectional, qualitative study.Methods:Semi-structured interviews with a purposive patient sample prescribed intraocular pressure (IOP)-lowering eyedrops and ophthalmologists involved in glaucoma care at a tertiary center.

pmc-12737589.title: Microorganism-Based Strategies for the Control of Cyanobacterial Blooms: A Review of Recent Progress
pmc-12737589.creator: Wangle Zhang, Shiyuan Meng, Xiaoxu Wu, Hong Shen, Dongqin Wang, Tong Qiu, Weijie Li, Jiping Chen, Ling Li, Bingbing Liang, Mengdi Zhao, Xuwei Deng, Chi Zhou
pmc-12737589.description: Cyanobacterial blooms, which are increasingly exacerbated by eutrophication and climate change, pose threats to ecosystems and public health. This paper systematically reviews recent advances in microbial intervention strategies for controlling cyanobacterial blooms. Current approaches primarily comprise direct lysis methods, indirect suppression methods, and integrated strategies.

pmc-12847828.title: Spatio-temporal Attention driven Rainfall Inference using Transformative Architecture (SARITA)
pmc-12847828.creator: Ishan Sharma, Sarita Azad, Ankur Suri, Ali H. Omar
pmc-12847828.description: Short-term rainfall forecasting presents a complex spatiotemporal modeling challenge, critical for adaptation and mitigation of high-impact hydrometeorological events such as flash floods and cloudbursts. This study examines hourly rainfall patterns in the Northwest Himalayan (NWH) region of India, enhancing forecasting accuracy using spatial correlations.

pmc-13257538.title: Mixed Monolayer Characteristics of Tangeretin with Stearic Acid and Dipalmitoyl Phosphatidyl Choline at the Air/Water Interface
pmc-13257538.creator: Yawen Zhou, Wanqing Wang, Tianqi Jia, Yifan Zhang, Nan Wang, Baocai Xu
pmc-13257538.description: As a natural compound with various biological activities, tangeretin (TAN) has numerous potential advantages in food and medical fields. However, its poor aqueous solubility and bioavailability limit its effective application. In this paper, the mixed monolayer characteristics of different mass fractions of TAN with stearic acid (SA) and dipalmitoyl phosphatidyl choline (DPPC) were investigated.

pmc-13300249.title: A comparison of leadless and conventional transvenous pacemakers in elderly patients: short-term outcomes systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13300249.creator: A Aurelio Marinho Rosa Filho, R Fonseca Oliveira Suruagy Motta, G Ribeiro De Sales, E Damiani Bertoli, V Morales Ribeiro, C Alexandre Farias, L Dexheimer Da Silva, E Galvao De Oliveira Oldra, D Abraham Batista Da Hora, S Rodrigo De Ramalho Moraes, G Dagostin De Carvalho
pmc-13300249.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLeadless pacemakers (LPMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional transvenous pacemakers (TVPs), particularly in reducing complications related to the pacemaker pocket and leads. This potential advantage could offer significant benefits to certain patient populations.

pmc-13424329.title: Behavioural adaptation of 158 rescued dogs from abroad during the first six months after adoption in Germany
pmc-13424329.creator: Lisa Hoth-Zimak, Janina Kickstein, André Klima, Henriette Mackensen, Esther Müller, Helen Louton, Dorothea Döring
pmc-13424329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In several European countries, adopting rescued dogs from abroad is common, but the dogs’ behaviour has rarely been studied. This first prospective study involved five telephone interviews with 151 owners of 158 dogs from 18 countries. The first interview, collecting each dog’s preliminary data given to the owner by the animal welfare organisation, took place before or few days after adoption to households in Germany, the subsequent ones at one, six and twelve weeks and six months post-adoption.

pmc-13554152.title: Cumulative microscopy reveals cellular states in fibroblasts from patients with genetic disorders
pmc-13554152.creator: Karen Akopyan, Zhiyu Hao, Susann Karlberg, Svetlana Vakkilainen, Fulya Taylan, Minna Pekkinen, Outi Mäkitie, Arne Lindqvist

pmc-13559638.title: Expression of the NLRP12/NF-κB/iNOS axis in lung tissues across stages of non-small cell lung cancer and its mechanism in mediating immune cell regulation
pmc-13559638.creator: Mingqiang Xue, Mingrui Shi, Jialing Chen, Xiaoming Wu
pmc-13559638.description: BackgroundPatients with lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC), a subtype of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), face a dismal prognosis. Immune evasion driven by an imbalanced tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) and an abnormal enrichment of regulatory T cells (Tregs) is a central pathogenic mechanism, yet the regulatory pathways involved remain elusive.

pmc-13576112.title: Plasma cyclophilin a as a novel predictor of major adverse cardiac events in patients with acute myocardial injury cohort study
pmc-13576112.creator: Chaopu Zhang, Wei Zhong, Xiang Tang, Xia Sun
pmc-13576112.description: BackgroundCyclophilin A (CypA) is a multifaceted immunophilin implicated in cardiovascular disease; however, its predictive value for Major Adverse Cardiac Events (MACEs) after acute myocardial injury remains poorly defined.PurposeThe study aimed to analyze whether admission Plasma CyPA independently predicts MACEs and to assess its predictive feasibility beyond recognized clinical risk factors.

pmc-13666798.title: A Colorimetric Strategy for Arsenic(V) Determination in Rice via Boosting the Peroxidase-like Activity of NCuzyme
pmc-13666798.creator: Lei Xu, Mao-Ling Luo, Shan Qiu, Jing-Jing Dai, Huan Zhu, Feng-Qing Yang
pmc-13666798.description: Arsenic (As) is extremely poisonous, and prolonged exposure greatly raises the likelihood of developing cancer. It is crucial to develop selective and sensitive methods for detecting As. In this study, using melamine and Cu(II), a Cu-based complex (NCuzyme) with peroxidase (POD)-like activity was prepared using a green and simple approach for the first time.
